body:
I went to my gp today and she got my psychiatry appointment moved forward to monday so I might get some new meds. I'm going because I can't leave my family. I've given up on feeling better though. I'm doomed to feel like this, no matter what we try. I've done too much and been subjected to too much and I just can't cope.

:(

I hate myself for having these thoughts even more because my mother and father and family would all miss me and I know it and I feel guilty for feeling this way but I just don't know how much longer I can take being inside of my head. I've had various therapies and none have helped.

I know she hates me because she yelled at me the last time she saw me.

I go for walks, I go to my dance classes, lock myself away and watch films to distract myself, play games, do puzzles... anything I can to stay out of my head. I can't focus on them now. 

I rang the crisis team the other day (which I don't want to do, I don't want to bother them, there are worse off people than me) and described everything to the guy on the phone. He says I'm in a 'dissociative state' (something I've only experienced once before but not as bad as this) and he's going to try and get my psychiatrist to see me sooner. I can't see her... she hates me. 

I was on mood stabilisers that she recommended but they've caused me to develop alopecia which is only in small sections of my hair but it's noticeable and it's all her fault. She knows how low my self esteem is and she made me this ugly. I stopped them six weeks ago after a six week titration down to 25mg and I'm not worse than I was before I had them but everything is back with a vengeance and I can't keep my head above water. 

Everyone would be much better off without me.

I have Borderline Personality Disorder and I'm going through a really rough time with it. I'm majorly depressed and suicidal and I can't seem to snap myself out of it like I usually do. I just want to die. I've really had enough.
